A LITTLE METHOD TO THE MAGIC

Don’t leave your intent
up to interpretation.

AI doesn’t have the full picture in your head. A structured prompt makes your goal, your context, and your expectations visible.

THE STARTING THOUGHT

“Write something
for my website.”

A perfectly good idea. With a few missing pieces.

THE INTENTIONAL PROMPT
◎ Role

You are an experienced website copywriter.

↗ Task

Write a welcoming homepage introduction.

≡ Context

For a neighborhood pottery studio welcoming beginners.

▤ Output

One headline and a paragraph under 80 words. Warm, plain language.

01 / STRUCTURE

Give every detail
a home.

Blocks separate the job from the background, the constraints from the output. They become familiar Markdown sections your model can follow.

02 / INTENTION

You make the
important calls.

Choose the goal, define the boundaries, and decide what success means. This tool organizes your instructions; your judgment gives them purpose.

03 / ITERATION

A starting point.
Then a conversation.

Copy your prompt into your preferred AI, review what comes back, and refine. Clear instructions help, but you still decide whether the result is right.
